contentPattern: Row 1: one full-width image. Row 2: caption rich text (optional heading plus paragraph). On desktop (992px and up) the caption sits in a white card offset one column from the left, overlapping the bottom of the image, with a short rule beneath; below 992px the card stacks under the image.
usage: News articles: a large interior or exterior photo with a descriptive caption card overlapping its lower-left corner.
reuseGuidance: Use only for a single photo with an overlapping caption. For downloadable press images use media-image; for text beside an image use columns-press-image.
prototypeCounterpart: none (no prototype module); text values follow css/defender-en-gb-news-*.css .article-text p
